parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` — `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveMaster` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package `Metadata`) and `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveArtist` in `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package `app:iOS`). These are test-local mock methods whose structural similarity (Jaccard 0.71) reflects the shared mock-resolver pattern, not accidental duplication of production logic. Merging or genericizing them would couple two independent test suites and risk obscuring the distinct domain concepts each test exercises (`resolveMaster` vs. `resolveArtist`). The restraint rule mandates no-action when any participating record is a test fixture, and both records here are.
